title: Clawd X Digest
summary: Stanford 'Modern Software Developer' 2026 Syllabus: Mihail Eric announced the Fall 2026 update for Stanford's software developer course, overhauling 85% of content to focus on AI-native engineering, coding agents (Claude Opus 4.5, Cursor, Claude Code), MCP portals, and open-source contributions.
Sam Altman on ChatGPT Energy & Water Usage: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman shared that running 38,000 ChatGPT queries consumes equivalent water to producing a single California almond.
US–Venezuela 65B Barrel Oil Deal Signed: The US and Venezuela officially finalized an energy agreement giving America majority operational control over 65 billion barrels of crude reserves.

US Treasury on Strait of Hormuz Bypass: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent stated that strategic bypass routes will render the Strait of Hormuz virtually irrelevant for global oil transit within 2 years.
Grok Android Release & Image 2.0: xAI opened Google Play pre-registration for the official Grok Android app alongside the rollout of Grok Image 2.0 with multi-image compositing and style controls.

items.title: @mihail_eric: Stanford Course 'The Modern Software Developer' 2026 Update
items.body: Mihail Eric announced the Fall 2026 syllabus for Stanford's CS course, discarding 85% of prior material to focus on AI-native software engineering, MCP portals, agentic code review, and PR contributions to top OSS repos (Browserbase, CopilotKit, Vercel, Semgrep).

items.title: @unusual_whales: Sam Altman Compares ChatGPT Query Footprint to Almond Production
items.body: Sam Altman highlighted AI resource efficiency, noting that 38,000 ChatGPT queries consume the same amount of water used to grow a single California almond.

items.title: @poteto: Grok Android App Opens Google Play Pre-Registration
items.body: The Grok team announced that the official Grok Android app is nearing launch, opening pre-registration for users on the Google Play Store.

items.title: @grok: xAI Rolls Out Grok Image 2.0 for High-Fidelity Synthesis
items.body: xAI introduced Grok Image 2.0, featuring advanced style controls, multi-image compositing capabilities, and fast iterative visual generation.

items.title: @rahulbais136: Google NotebookLM Expands into Autonomous AI Workflow Engine
items.body: Updates to Google NotebookLM transform it beyond PDF summarization into a multi-format AI execution system with automated data processing pipelines.

items.title: @QwenDevs: Qwen Developers Release Technical Deep Dive on Local Search
items.body: Qwen Devs published 'From rg to zg: Local Search Beyond Keywords', detailing semantic and structural code search techniques for developer tools.

items.title: @Supermicro: Supermicro & NVIDIA Expand Enterprise AI Factory Solutions
items.body: Supermicro showcased turnkey AI infrastructure pairing high-density GPU computing with liquid-cooled server architectures for enterprise LLM clusters.

items.title: @WatcherGuru: US & Venezuela Sign Deal for Control Over 65 Billion Barrels of Oil
items.body: The United States and Venezuela signed a bilateral energy agreement establishing US majority management over 65 billion barrels of Venezuelan oil reserves.

items.title: @WatcherGuru: Treasury Secretary Bessent Predicts Strait of Hormuz Bypass in 2 Years
items.body: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent announced plans and infrastructure timeline to bypass the Strait of Hormuz within 2 years, neutralizing its global oil bottleneck role.
